-- ================================================

--  ✅ أضيفت: لوحة تحكم المالك + حظر + طرد
-- ================================================

local R = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()
local Pl, Rs, ReS, TWe, CG, UIS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("TweenService"), game:GetService("CoreGui"), game:GetService("UserInputService")
local P = Pl.LocalPlayer

-- ==============================================
-- 👑 إعدادات المالك والحظر
-- ==============================================
local OwnerConfig = {
    OwnerName = "Alskndrany_9999",
    OwnerUserId = 10841397475, -- ضع رقم حسابك هنا
    KickDurationHours = 24,
    BannedMessage = "🚫 أنت محظور من استخدام هذا السكربت\nتواصل مع المطور لفك الحظر.",
}

-- قائمة الحظر المحلية
local BAN_LIST = {
    usernames = {},
    userids = {},
}

-- هل أنت المالك؟
local function isOwner()
    return P.Name == OwnerConfig.OwnerName or P.UserId == OwnerConfig.OwnerUserId
end

-- فحص الحظر
local function isBanned()
    if isOwner() then return false end
    local username = P.Name
    local userId = P.UserId
    for _, name in ipairs(BAN_LIST.usernames) do
        if name:lower() == username:lower() then return true end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(BAN_LIST.userids) do
        if tonumber(id) == userId then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- إذا الشخص محظور نطرده فوراً
if isBanned() then
    P:Kick("\n" .. OwnerConfig.BannedMessage)
    return
end

-- إشعار بداية التحميل
if isOwner() then
    R:Notify({Title = "👑 مرحباً يا مالك!", Content = "لوحة التحكم جاهزة في قسم 'لوحة المالك'", Duration = 4})
end

pcall(function()setclipboard("https://chat.whatsapp.com/DhimlS3ZfxOBzr0dF5eCPu")end)

local function dA()for _,c in ipairs(Cn)do pcall(function()c:Disconnect()end)end;table.clear(Cn)end

local function gH()local c=gC();return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")end
local function gHu()local c=gC();return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")end
local function rP()local h=gH();if h and lSc then pcall(function()h.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;h.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero;h.CFrame=lSc+Vector3.new(0,5,0)end)end end
local function gTP(n)if n==""then return nil end;for _,v in pairs(Pl:GetPlayers())do if v~=P and(v.Name:lower():find(n:lower())or v.DisplayName:lower():find(n:lower()))then return v end end end
local function lookAtTarget()local t=gTP(tN);if not t then R:Notify({Title="⚠️ تنبيه",Content="لم اجد لاعب بهذا الاسم!",Duration=3});return end;local tc,mc=t.Character,gC();local tr,mr=tc and tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),mc and mc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if not(tr and mr)then return end;local d=(tr.Position-mr.Position).Unit;mr.CFrame=CFrame.new(mr.Position,mr.Position+Vector3.new(d.X,0,d.Z));R:Notify({Title="👁 تم التوجيه ✅",Content="تنظر لـ "..t.DisplayName,Duration=2})end

local function sAl()if not Al then return end;task.spawn(function()while Al do pcall(function()for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants())do if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter")then v.Enabled=false;task.wait(0.1);v.Enabled=true elseif v:IsA("Trail")or v:IsA("Beam")or v:IsA("Smoke")then v.Enabled=false elseif v:IsA("Explosion")then v:Destroy()elseif v:IsA("Fire")then v.Size=0 end end end);task.wait(5)end end)end

local savePosUnder,underConn,origMaxH,godCharConn=nil,nil,100,nil
local function sUP()if not Ue then dA();return end;dA();task.wait(0.4);table.insert(Cn,Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()pcall(function()local h=gH();if h then lSc=h.CFrame end end)end));table.insert(Cn,Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()if not Ue then return end;pcall(function()local c,h,hu=gC(),gH(),gHu();if not(c and h and hu)then return end;hu:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,false);if hu:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then hu:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)end;for _,p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA("BasePart")then p.CanCollide=true;p.Anchored=false end end;h.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero;if h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude>MxS then rP()end;h.CustomPhysicalProperties=PhysicalProperties.new(0.01,0,0,0,0)end)end));table.insert(Cn,Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()if not Ue then return end;pcall(function()local h=gH();if not h then return end;local n=tick();if n-lC<0.15 then return end;lC=n;if h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y<MxF or h.Position.Y<MY then rP()end end)end));sAf();sAc();sAl()end
local function cTB()pcall(function()local RE=ReS:WaitForChild("RE",3);if not RE then return end;local TR=RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eTex1t");if TR then TR:FireServer("RolePlayName","");TR:FireServer("RolePlayBio","")end;local CR=RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eColo1r");if CR then CR:FireServer("PickingRPNameColor",Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255));CR:FireServer("PickingRPBioColor",Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))end end)end
local function sRT(tT,bT)if iRa then iRa=false;task.wait(0.2)end;cTB();task.wait(0.1);iRa=true;pcall(function()local RE=ReS:WaitForChild("RE",3);if not RE then return end;local TR=RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eTex1t");if TR then TR:FireServer("RolePlayName",tT);TR:FireServer("RolePlayBio",bT)end end);task.spawn(function()local RE=ReS:WaitForChild("RE",3);if not RE then return end;local CR=RE:FindFirstChild("1RPNam1eColo1r");if not CR then return end;local h=0;while iRa do local c=Color3.fromHSV(h,1,1);pcall(function()CR:FireServer("PickingRPNameColor",c);CR:FireServer("PickingRPBioColor",c)end);h=(h+0.04)%1;task.wait(sI[cSl]or 0.1)end end)end

task.spawn(function()pcall(function()local RE,Rm=ReS:WaitForChild("RE",3),ReS:WaitForChild("Remotes",3);if Rm then local T=Rm:WaitForChild("TelemetryClientInteraction",3);if T then T:FireServer("uiInteraction",{["buttonName"]="Popout",["inVehicle"]=false});task.wait(0.1);T:FireServer("uiInteraction",{["buttonName"]="NameHudButton",["inVehicle"]=false})end end;if RE then local F=RE:WaitForChild("1Flyin1g",3);if F then F:FireServer("CheckForServerOwner");F:FireServer("PCollisionPatch")end end end);task.wait(1.5);if iF then sRT(dT,dB);iF=false end end)

local W=R:CreateWindow({Name="3am El Magal 💸",LoadingTitle="♾️ جاري التحميل.. ♾️",LoadingSubtitle="مطور: إِسْـكَـنْـدَرَانِـي ⃝💸",ConfigurationSaving={Enabled=false},Theme="BlackConsole"})

NT:CreateSection("ادوات السكربت الخاصه")
NT:CreateToggle({Name="🦘 قفز لانهائي",CurrentValue=false,Callback=function(s)infJump=s;R:Notify({Title=s and "🦘 تفعيل ✅"or "🔓 إيقاف",Content=s and "اقفز كمان مرة وأنت في الهواء!"or "تم الإيقاف",Duration=2})end})
NT:CreateToggle({Name="☠️ حماية من التفعيل (موت مؤكد VR7)",CurrentValue=false,Callback=function(s)isUnderground=s;if isUnderground then local hrp=gH();if not hrp then R:Notify({Title="❌ خطأ",Content="ما لقيتش الشخصية!",Duration=2});isUnderground=false;return end;savePosUnder=hrp.CFrame;local hu=gHu();if hu then origMaxH=hu.MaxHealth;pcall(function()hu.MaxHealth=1000000000;hu.Health=1000000000;hu.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;hu:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false)end)end;R:Notify({Title="☠️ تم التفعيل ✅",Content="حماية موت مؤكد شغال! أي VR7 يلحقك يموت فوراً 💀",Duration=3});local killD={-1000000,-1500000,-2000000,-3000000,-5000000,-7000000,-10000000,-20000000,-30000000,-50000000,-70000000,-100000000,-200000000,-300000000,-500000000,-700000000,-900000000,-1000000000,-1500000000,-2000000000};local ki=0;underConn=Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()pcall(function()if not isUnderground then return end;ki=ki+7;local kd=killD[(ki%#killD)+1];local ox=math.random(-30,30);local oz=math.random(-30,30);killForces();local h=gH();if h then h.CFrame=CFrame.new(savePosUnder.Position.X+ox,kd,savePosUnder.Position.Z+oz)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(ki*40),0);h.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;h.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end;local hu2=gHu();if hu2 then hu2.Health=hu2.MaxHealth end end)end)else isUnderground=false;if underConn then underConn:Disconnect();underConn=nil end;local hu=gHu();if hu then pcall(function()hu:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,true);hu.MaxHealth=origMaxH;hu.Health=origMaxH;hu.BreakJointsOnDeath=true end)end;if savePosUnder then local h=gH();if h then h.CFrame=savePosUnder;h.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;h.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end;R:Notify({Title="✅ تم الإيقاف",Content="رجعت لمكانك ✅",Duration=3})end;savePosUnder=nil end end})
NT:CreateToggle({Name="💀 حماية من الموت بالقوة 👑",CurrentValue=false,Callback=function(s)if P.Name~="Alskndrany_9999"and P.UserId~=10841397475 then R:Notify({Title="🔒 مقفل",Content="هذا الزر خاص بصاحب السكربت @Alskndrany_9999 فقط!",Duration=5});return end;godMode=s;if godMode then local hu=gHu();if hu then origMaxH=hu.MaxHealth;pcall(function()hu.MaxHealth=1000000000;hu.Health=1000000000;hu.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;hu:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false)end)end;safePosGod=gH()and gH().CFrame or nil;R:Notify({Title="💀 حماية الموت بالقوة مفعلة ✅👑",Content="أنت مستحيل تموت! أي حد ينزلك تحت ترجع فوراً + مقاومة فلنج",Duration=5});godConn=Rs.Heartbeat:Connect(function()pcall(function()if not godMode then return end;killForces();local hu=gHu();local h=gH();if hu then hu.Health=hu.MaxHealth;if hu.MaxHealth<1000000 then hu.MaxHealth=1000000000 end;hu.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;if hu:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then hu:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)end end;if h then if not isUnderground and h.Position.Y>-100 then safePosGod=h.CFrame end;if not isUnderground and h.Position.Y<-250 and safePosGod then h.CFrame=safePosGod;h.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;h.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end;if h.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude>250 then h.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;h.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero end end end)end);godCharConn=P.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()task.wait(1.2);if godMode then pcall(function()local hu=gHu();if hu then hu.MaxHealth=1000000000;hu.Health=1000000000;hu.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;hu:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false)end end)end end)else if godConn then godConn:Disconnect();godConn=nil end;if godCharConn then godCharConn:Disconnect();godCharConn=nil end;local hu=gHu();if hu then pcall(function()hu:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,true);hu.MaxHealth=origMaxH;hu.Health=origMaxH;hu.BreakJointsOnDeath=true end)end;R:Notify({Title="🔓 تم الإيقاف",Content="تم إيقاف حماية الموت",Duration=3})end end})

task.spawn(function()pcall(function()wait(1.5);local target=nil;for _,d in ipairs(CG:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("TextLabel")and d.Text and d.Text:find("حماية من الموت بالقوة")then target=d.Parent;break end end;if target then local st=Instance.new("UIStroke");st.Thickness=2.5;st.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border;st.Parent=target;local h=0;while task.wait(0.06)do h=(h+0.025)%1;st.Color=Color3.fromHSV(h,1,1)end end end)end)

local function sAM()aM=nil;if cT then pcall(function()cT:Stop()end);cT=nil end end
local function pCA(id)local hu=gHu();if not hu then return end;sAM();local a=Instance.new("Animation");local rId=tostring(id);local ok,objs=pcall(function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..rId)end);if ok and objs and #objs>0 then for _,v in ipairs(objs)do if v:IsA("Animation")then a=v;break elseif v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")then a=v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation");break end end else a.AnimationId="rbxassetid://"..rId end;local an=hu:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")or Instance.new("Animator",hu);cT=an:LoadAnimation(a);cT.Looped=true;cT:AdjustSpeed(aS);cT:Play()end
